intro: The Alpine recliner is our invitation to unwind. With a soft, floating seat feel, smooth manual reclining, and high back support, it wraps your body in comfort and your mind in stillness.

features.title: Recline into your moment
features.text: Our smooth, noiseless manual mechanism lets you shift from alert to at ease effortlessly—because you deserve control over your comfort.

features.title: We support every inch
features.text: A high backrest with integrated head and lumbar support means your whole body feels aligned, from head to hips.

features.title: A hug, disguised as a seat
features.text: Soft conjugated polyester fibre cushions and plush foam cradle you gently, creating that ‘just right’ feeling every time you sit.

features.title: Easy to clean, hard to wear out
features.text: Upholstered in synthetic leather with high resistance to peeling, scratches and abrasion, our sofa stays sleek and strong for the long run.

features.title: Comfort that holds you, fully
features.text: Generous armrests, an integrated footrest, and a recline angle up to 135° with enhanced lumbar support deliver that full-body sigh of relief—day after day.

name: Alpine 1-Seater Synthetic Leather Manual Recliner Sofa
